## What changed

Two files, four lines — the route and the URL builder for the decisions playground now say `/ml-inference/playground`:

- `products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx:15` — route key `'/ml-inference/decisions'` → `'/ml-inference/playground'`, still mapped to the same scene (`DecisionPlayground`) and the same URL key (`decisionPlayground`).
- `products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx:19` — `urls.decisionPlayground()` returns the new path.
- `frontend/src/products.tsx:221` and `:1498` — the generated aggregate of all product manifests, carrying the same two changes. It's a tracked, generated file ("Generated by build-products.mjs – DO NOT EDIT BY HAND"), so it has to move with the manifest or the app would keep serving the old path.

Nothing else in the repo needed touching, and I checked for it:

- Every in-app link goes through `urls.decisionPlayground()` (the only call site is `DecisionPlayground.stories.tsx:55`), so links follow the manifest automatically. The playground has no nav/menu entry of its own — `treeItemsNew` and `treeItemsProducts` are empty and it's reached by URL behind the `ml-inference-decisions` flag.
- A repo-wide search for `ml-inference/decisions` (all file types, excluding `node_modules`/`.git`) now returns nothing — no snapshots, Playwright specs, docs, or Python references.
- The backend API route `ml_inference/decisions` (`products/ml_inference/backend/routes.py:7`) and the `ml-inference-decisions` feature flag key are untouched on purpose: those are the API path and a flag key, not the page address, and renaming either would change behavior.

No test added. The natural candidate — asserting the route resolves to the scene, like `products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastsRoutes.test.ts` — exists there because tab segments can shadow a `/:id` route. ML inference has one static route with no such ambiguity, so the test would only restate the constant it's next to, which the `/writing-tests` gate rules out. The existing `decisionPlaygroundLogic.test.ts` covers request building and is unaffected.

Two things to note:

- I didn't run typecheck or the generator: `node_modules` isn't installed here and you asked me not to install dependencies. `frontend/build-products.mjs` failed with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for that reason, so `products.tsx` was updated to exactly the lines the generator emits from the manifest rather than by running it. Worth a `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend build:products` diff check when deps are available; it should come back clean.
- The old address now 404s rather than redirecting, which matches "instead of". If you'd rather keep old bookmarks working, the manifest's `redirects` map is the place for a one-line `'/ml-inference/decisions': '/ml-inference/playground'` — say the word and I'll add it.
